Sari Toudou hard at work training under the supervision of her supervisor, Anjou. The employees of the comfort department are "once conceived, you're on your own". With this slogan in mind, she receives cum in her vagina, anus, and mouth-throat!

Fuyuka is a girl attending art college in Tokyo, against her parents' wishes. Her younger step-brother had always supported her, despite their strict upbringing, and she feels guilty about going away and leaving him alone at home. One day, she is at her wit's end because she can't afford to pay rent, when her brother, Ameon, suddenly shows up...! Now the siblings are living together, and her brother's love is too heavy for her to bear!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

169254.description:
The tomboy and the quiet girl don't seem to have much in common at first glance, except that they're head over heels in love. Ren is loud, brash, and possessive—a far cry from Shino's calmer, more reserved demeanor. But hey, sparks fly in the most unlikely cases, and this couple can barely keep their hands off each other. Between Ren's aggressive flirting and Shino's adorable personality, if one of them isn't blushing, whoever's reading along with them sure will be.

(Source: Yen Press)

169255.description:
A foxgirl deity is enshrined at the shrine which a certain human often pays homage to.
Impressed with his devoutness, she decides to fulfil his wish for "procreation."
However, as he was not actually praying for fertility or anything like that, the human is quite bewildered.
Totally oblivious to this fact, the deity assumes that's what he wants... and takes immediate action...

169257.description:
A ferry carrying kids on a school trip gets lost and washes up on a deserted island... where they find all sorts of creatures that they have never seen before! The group plays with the creatures, who seems cute and harmless, but are they really...

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

169260.description:
Run by a young man passionate about literature, the small secondhand bookstore Jugatsudo welcomes a diverse array of visitors every day: lifelong book lovers, a high school student hoping to mark her transition into adulthood through reading, a widow who has come to part with her late husband’s collection, a man who seems to want to get rid of some books... Each need is an opportunity for the bookseller to connect, if only for a few minutes, with a customer’s memories.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

In a fantastical world, a peculiar union takes place when Grill, a magical beast, ties the knot with the adorable Mimi, a member of the elf tribe.

169262.description:
Meishiro has an insatiable appetite for mystery above all else. At the mere whisper of an intriguing incident, he embarks on a journey to the remote hinterlands, accompanied by his gentlemanly escort, Todo.

(Source: Harta)

169263.description:
"I want... to see your O-face." Daigoro's an arrogant punk in high school and he's in love with the handsome and cool guy sitting next to him, Kazuki. One day, Kazuki invites Daigoro to his room for what seems like an innocent reason. But, what Daigoro sees there are the walls covered with his pictures and stolen personal items... It turns out the person he had a crush on was stalking him!! Then, to top it off, Kazuki then says, "Your photos and items don't satisfy me anymore" and starts to handcuff Daigoro...! Kazuki touches him all over, a normally uncomfortable position if it were not for Daigoro's crush on him. If he ravages Daigoro like this from both front and behind, especially his butt, the pleasure will make Daigoro lose his mind...! Despite Daigoro being a school punk... this eccentric, handsome guy is driving him to la la land...!

169267.description:
The mysterious world of Camelot is surrounded by the endless ocean, itself bounded by the gravitational frontier that swallows up everything that comes near. The inhabitants of this world have tried to cross this boundary using science and technology, but have failed...

As Peiluo, a young knight, escorts a convoy of merchants, she comes face to face with a stone giant! Peiluo demonstrates her exceptional swordsmanship, and her technique reveals similarities with that of a legendary knight: Lancelot!
synonyms: King's Knights - Mystic Emissary of Wonder

Hoshiko is a young girl in search of Prince Charming, but what happens when Yoshitsune, a delinquent and gang leader, falls under her spell? Is Yoshitsune the prince Hoshiko has been waiting for?

169271.description:
This spring, Io Yumabuki will start her second year of high school. At the opening ceremony, Wataru Naruchika, a childhood friend of hers, shows up as the new art teacher. Io and Wataru were next door neighbors and have been close family friends since childhood. But... they actually became a couple 3 months ago! Friends, lovers... and teacher! It's a heart-pounding relationship with "Naruchika-san"! A fearless adolescent love comedy!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: センセイだって彼氏です

169272.description:
When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn’t know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school’s broadcasting club. That’s where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four’s dreams pan out?

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: Tune In to the Midnight Heart

169273.description:
"Did you get scared after coming this far? Unfortunately, I can't stop now."

A hard-working office worker, Takamura, loses his sales performance to Maihara, an elite from the head office! Unable to keep losing, Takamura challenges Maihara to a one-on-one match on the condition that the loser listens to the winner's request, but... Takamura, who is defeated by a narrow margin, is taken to a love hotel by Maihara!? Maihara, who exposes his body while being fueled with Takamura's determination not to lose, teaches him about pleasures... A cool elite vs. a handsome man who hates to lose, rival office workers' love story!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

169274.description:
Akagi, a serious student, and Rei Inukai, a quiet high school girl and his senpai, got really chewed out by their respective teachers for skipping school for a week. But it's not like the two of them could just straight up tell their teachers they were actually busy having SEX all week long, so they just promised each other to "Hold back from having sex on school days".

And so several days later, the moment I went to visit senpai's home, our pent-up lust immediately exploded into sex, serving as the opening bell to our session♪ Senpai is so horny she'd insert my dick while we were still at the entry corridor inside her house, and she'll gladly grant any request from me who held back for a week, be it about her boobs or her butt♪

From the sommelier of beautiful yet secretly lewd girls, Enokido-sensei presents this after story for his impactful debut work! ☆

Published in COMIC Anthurium 2023-05

169275.description:
Manami Konno is a 28-year-old designer working for a design company. She's asked to train Shiroi, the hot newbie, but he's already an incredibly efficient worker! That's why when he asks for some of her time after work, she worries that he might want to quit, but then he drops a different bombshell on her altogether: he's actually an alien! Without any time to digest the fact that he wants her to choose between "being his mate" and "human extinction," he asks to check their physical chemistry and pushes her down after coming into her house... That's when yet another mind-blowing detail is revealed!! He actually has... two members!? Just what's gonna become of Manami!?

(Source: Renta!)

169276.description:
After a cruel and calculated reign, Kai Lekius, the Sanguinary King, brought stability and peace to his once fragmented land. Thus began his deathlike slumber as he awaited the rise of magic, leaving the rest in the capable hands of his brother. Three hundred years later, he wakes as a True Blood, an immortal vampire of immense power. However, even after all that time, magic hasn’t progressed at all! A nobility system, which he has no recollection of establishing, tyrannizes the weak and weary of the new world. Though it displeases him greatly, Kai must once again postpone his studies and save his people once and for all!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Greatest Magician's Ultimate Quest: I Woke from a 300 Year Slumber to a World of Disappointment
title.native: 魔術の果てを求める大魔術師～魔道を極めた俺が三百年後の技術革新を期待して転生したら、哀しくなるほど退化していた……～

169277.description:
When Iris Locha gazes into the enchanted mirror inherited from her parents, she's met with a haunting glimpse of what lies ahead. A future where she grapples with a terminal illness, and her husband's mistress relentlessly pressures her to abandon her husband and child. Amidst the dark secrets, sinister plots, and misunderstandings, can Iris carve out her path to happiness?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: Steal the Child of the Terminally Ill
รักระยะสุดท้าย
余命わずかな私、子どもまで奪われそうです

title.english: They Wish to Take Away My Child

169278.description:
When Princess Fleta, who has been mistreated her entire life due to being born with a curse, summons the basilisk and destroys the palace, Princess Cezanne regrets that things could have turned out differently if someone had been by Fleta's side. So when she miraculously finds herself six years back in time, she is determined to take Fleta under her wing and fill her baby sister's life with nothing but joyful light. Will Cezanne be able to dispel the darkness inside Fleta and rewrite the ending?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Raised My Younger Sister Beautifully
คราวนี้ฉันจะเลี้ยงน้องเป็นอย่างดี

169279.description:
The elementary school boy Naoki has to live with his grandparents in Wakayama because his parents moved abroad for work. Trying to make Naoki happy, his grandparents prepare traditional sweets and snacks, which all seem new and exciting to a city boy like Naoki! The life in the countryside starts with all sorts famous local sweets and homemade snacks, set in beautiful natural scenery, surrounded by mountains and the sea!

(Source: Comic Piatto, translated)
synonyms: なおくんと甘やかしおやつ。

title.native: なおくんと和歌山おやつ。

169280.description:
Paresa Menzel, lured by the promise of high pay, agrees to serve the empress who is known to be a cruel villainess. Anticipating evil incarnate, she instead finds a complex woman with hidden scars, which makes her solidify her vow to aid her. However, Paresa seems to be hiding something, which causes the crown prince to become suspicious of her. Though his captivating beauty unnerves her and challenges her resolve, Paresa's steadfast loyalty to the empress stands firm. Will her hidden past endanger them, or will it forge unexpected bonds in this dangerous game of deception and loyalty?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Exclusive Maid of the Evil Empress

169281.description:
Adaptation of the movie with the same name. With a parallel ending…!?

What happens when an unsuccessful mangaka sees the face of a murderer?
What if he turns that face into a “character” and draws a bestselling manga with it?
A beautiful psychopath meets an inexperienced mangaka. When these two unrelated people get involved with each other, it develops into a horrifying serial murder case. Be sure to see the original ending of the manga, which is different from the movie.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

169282.description:
After an accident, Ye Ling transmigrated to a fantastical world where everyone had spirit-taming powers. He managed to activate the Spirit Taming System, which allows him to see evolutionary paths invisible to normal people. For every level he gains, he can tame a new spirit-pet. Ye Ling's first spirit-pet turns out to be a zombie, which seems like the weakest pet to everyone else, but Ye Ling can see that his zombie is a super spirit-pet!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Tamer: My Spirit Pet is a Female Zombie!
Taming Spiritual Pets: My Spiritual Pet is a Female Zombie

title.romaji: Quan Min Yu Ling: Wo De Lingchong Shi Nü Jiangshi

169283.description:
Ishigami often hangs out with delinquents, which gives others the impression that he's a "scary" guy and isolating him from his peers. In order to help restore his image, he pairs up with Suzumura, a member of the disciplinary committee, to do community service. Suzumura happens to be famously flirty, and after finishing the community service, he suggests some kissing practice...

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: 金曜日の放課後は奉仕とキスを
title.romaji: Kinyoubi no Houkago wa Houshi to Kiss wo

169284.description:
The "Hero of Love," who can turn love into power, is humanity's last hope. However, he has a fatal weakness called "Being Awfully Bad at Romance"...

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.romaji: Ai no Yuusha wo Kouryakuse yo

169286.description:
A family consisting of a mother with dementia, a sick father, and a son who left his job in Seoul to return to the countryside.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169287.description:
Yeon-U is a genius composer known for creating only sad music. With a concert right around the corner and an unfinished composition, not to mention a scandal erupting, he flees to the countryside to focus on his work. While borrowing a piano at his nephew's music academy, he reunites with his first love, who guided him into the world of piano. Yeon-U, who has always been blunt and rarely smiled, finds himself creating warm and lovely music unlike his previous compositions, all thanks to the cheerful Eun-Seong. Can their meeting inspire a new, heartwarming melody?!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169288.description:
When did my male friend start looking good?

Fifteen years old, a turbulent time. Baba Middle School is full of bewildered children with rapidly changing bodies and minds, and our protagonist, Dan A-Eun, is the most confused of them all. She's starting to have feelings for Han Dong-U, her classmate of 10 years...? It's my heart, but even I'm not sure!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

169289.description:
Jeong-Ha, a vampire, is about to give up on life, as he's so tired of the widespread scorn and disgust. Ji-Eun saves him, and a strange relationship begins between the vampire boy and the girl who needs his blood.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169292.description:
Byeoridoryeong is a netherworld shaman who has made a name for himself by picking off those who delay their deaths. One day, as he goes about his business, he receives news of the theft of the Jewel of Beauty, which he keeps in the Heavenly Palace. Can he find it and restore his honour as a prince?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169293.description:
Na Yeong-Gwang, a 13-month-old Hanbit swimming ace, tries to win her crush's heart by competing in a swimming competition. But the problem is that it's a team competition! The four unique babies are a fantastic cacophony of personalities, swimming with second-rate bodies that can barely hold it together! They'll have to use the strength they've gained from milk, or rather, their breastfeeding strength, to win!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169294.description:
At a rural school with only two high school students, Min-Ji is sad that Ji-Hun, who is only concerned with studying, says he will leave for the city. One day, a transfer student, Yu-Jin, appears in the classroom where it was just the two of them..?!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Note: Originally published on Manhwakyung until its shutdown, later re-published on Naver on 2025.06.26.

title.native: 禁欲天使のギルティご飯

169298.description: This time the series is about Jack Hanma, the brother of the current main character Baki. The Baki Rahen series focuses on the character of Jack, his own path in life and his constant struggle to gain more and more strength.

title.native: 雌母〜息子の同級生に抱かれて堕ちる人妻〜
title.romaji: Mesumama: Musuko no Doukyuusei ni Dakarete Ochiru Hitozuma

169300.description:
Kanoko is the highly respected prefect of the dorm at a prestigious girls' boarding school. So much so that she is called the "Emperor" of the dorm. She and Tsumugihime, who is known for her beauty, play the role of an "ideal couple," but their true feelings are not so innocent. Because Tsumugihime has a secret that they doesn't know…

(Source: Sukima, translated)

169301.description:
Pon is a raccoon living in the forest who lost his home due to land development.
With vengeance in his heart, he sneaks into Kunio's preschool to take revenge against the humans...
Only to find smart phones, games, snacks, and instant noodles. Human life is the best!

(Source: Comic Piatto, translated)

Note: Originally serialized by the name 4-saiji to Tanuki (4歳児とたぬき). The title was changed for the tankoubon volume.

169302.description:
Laika has settled into the role of a rather prim young lady at the House in the Highlands—but was she always that way? Or was she more of a hot-blooded dragon... as red as her scales? In the second spin-off of the Killing Slimes series, the school days of Azusa’s oldest companion will be revealed!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Spin-off: The Red Dragon Academy for Girls
title.native: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました スピンオフ レッドドラゴン女学院
title.romaji: Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level MAX ni Nattemashita Spin-off: Red Dragon Jogakuin

169303.description:
Yun-Seul is a fan of fairy tales and crazy about princesses and princes. Vincent, a prince from a “real” fairy tale, suddenly appears in front of her. But this prince says he doesn't know the feeling of "love"...! Will Vincent be able to safely learn how to love and return to his own world?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169304.description:
Blueheart is a popular hip-hop duo in the Metaverse, but they don't know each other in real life. They are actually two seventeen-year-old classmates, Lee Sim and O Pa-Ran, who live next door to each other. As they participate in a hip-hop audition, they grow closer together, and as their virtual and real lives intertwine, their feelings for each other grow.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169305.description:
A former K-hagwon student, I'm a hagwon master? A K-hagwon survival story written by someone who has survived a total of 2N years of hagwon life in Korea.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Note: Originally published on Manhwakyung.

169306.description:
Lee Sol is an art student who sees ghosts. While looking for a place to live, she finds an office building. For some reason, the place is full of ghosts, but the price is too cheap. However, the residents are a bit strange. With a year and a half to go until she graduates from university, will she be able to survive in this apartment?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169307.description:
A world where you suddenly have superpowers. Jun-Uk, who has spent his life feeling inferior to his more successful brother, Jun-Su, gains the ability to crack shells. Frustrated by his insignificant abilities, he gradually discovers his true self...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169308.description:
One day, Cha-Seo, who is unemployed, receives a scouting offer from the director of a kindergarten called "Loop". What will Cha-Seo's day-to-day life be like at the centre for children who have been victims of abuse in their past lives?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169309.description:
No-Ha, a witch apprentice cursed by a dark witch, finds her powers sealed by the kiss of a boy she meets by chance. No-Ha has come to the human world to break the curse, but will she find the boy?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169310.description:
Ethan, the heir to the throne of Hynt, the city of the dead, has done everything he can to become king, but he is unable to make the final connection to the living, and is left to wander the earth.

Meanwhile, Mi-Ju, a medical student who is unhappy in her current life, receives an unexpected proposal for an arranged marriage. Just as she's wondering if this is the only way she'll ever be able to move on, she runs into Ethan in his skeleton form...!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169311.description:
The stories of those who live and have lived on this land.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169312.description:
Jin-Su, who is quite talented and good-looking, auditions for DNR Entertainment's new male idol group and is accepted as a trainee with dreams of debuting. In the midst of talent and hard work, he grows up crying and laughing, and builds memories with the other trainees... But one of them is destined to be eliminated - which of the five members will become your favourite?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

169313.description:
